description: In every PA-model, the course-of-values output is the specified step applied to its parameters, current index and actual preceding history.
signature:
Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.PAComputations.ProofPrograms.courseValue_value.{u} {M : Type u}
  [Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.ArithmeticTheories.language.Structure M] [M ⊨ Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.ArithmeticTheories.PA]
  {n : ℕ} (h : Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.PAComputations.Program (n + 2)) (x : Fin n → M) (k : M) :
  (Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.PAComputations.ProofPrograms.courseValue h).value (Fin.snoc x k) =
    h.value
      (Fin.snoc (Fin.snoc x k) ((Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.PAComputations.ProofPrograms.history h).value (Fin.snoc x k)))
